## p97 A, p97 B, p97 C — Communication through Hungary — wireless routing, repetition and supplies

<a id="edition-cases-radio-hungary-connection-and-supplies-communication-through-hungary--wireless-routing-repetition-and-supplies"></a>



**Source edition and review: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro.** Three separate
messages on Childs p. 97 concern retransmission, disrupted communication
through Hungary, and a reference to tubes and oil. Their typed source frames
contain 638 valid coordinates and match all three advertised lengths. The
unchanged November 1–3 key fixes all 319 raw plaintext positions.

The first two records need no coordinate repair. The proposed edition of the
third changes three plaintext labels through six observed-coordinate
substitutions. There are no erased slots, inserted or excluded source
coordinates, changed key cells, or changed numeral fields. The shared sender
and date do not make these three separate headings one multipart telegram.

### p97 A

[Source crop](../../experiments/hungary_connection_and_supplies/sources/p97_A.png). `A) OSM v LP (8.50 p.m., November 1st)` | `RICHI-196`.

<details>
<summary>Raw decoded text</summary>

**Raw output — all 196 observed coordinates; unchanged key.**

```text
SOFORTIGEWIEDERHOLUNGDORTIGENTELEGRXKOFCHIX56XX30STRICH10XXROEMX2XDX8XONHXVOMX30STRICH10XXKXMXANCH
```

</details>

**Readable German — the request, with unexplained reference fields kept literal:**

> Sofortige Wiederholung dortigen Telegr. `KOFCHIX56XX30STRICH10XXROEMX2XDX8XONHXVOMX30STRICH10XXKXMXANCH`.

The message requests immediate repetition of the indicated telegram. The
reference contains `CHI`, the number `56`, two `30STRICH10` strings, and an
unexpanded `ROEMX2XDX8XONH` field. This edition does not silently turn those
codes into a new message header or choose a grammatical expansion for them.
The physical source is marked `RICHI-196`; mentioning `CHI` in its body does
not establish use of a different key for this record.

All 98 raw labels are fixed. No edited stream is needed.

### p97 B

[Source crop](../../experiments/hungary_connection_and_supplies/sources/p97_B.png). `B) UKS v LP (8.29 p.m., November 1st)` | `1710 (1/11) POLITISCHE ABTEILUNG BUKAREST` | `RICHI-246`.

<details>
<summary>Raw decoded text</summary>

**Raw output — all 246 observed coordinates; unchanged key.**

```text
NRX608XDAVERBINDUNGDURCHXUNGARNXGESTOERTXGEHENTELEGRAMMEBISAUFWEITERESFUNKENTELEGRAPHISCHXEMPFANGSBESTAETIGUNGXAUSWAERTIGXX
```

</details>

**Readable German — spacing and punctuation only:**

> Nr. 608. Da Verbindung durch Ungarn gestoert, gehen Telegramme bis auf Weiteres funkentelegraphisch. Empfangsbestaetigung. Auswaertig.

The clear header addresses the political department in Bukarest. The body
says that communication through Hungary is disrupted and telegrams will be
sent by wireless until further notice; it asks for acknowledgment. The closing
`AUSWAERTIG` remains literal, without an invented personal signature.

All 123 raw labels are fixed. The earlier OCR frame had 241 slots and did not
produce this reading. Manual source transcription restores the visible
246-slot frame; that is an OCR correction, not a five-coordinate historical
insertion. No edited stream is needed.

### p97 C

[Source crop](../../experiments/hungary_connection_and_supplies/sources/p97_C.png). `C) UKS v LP (8.15 p.m., November 1st)` | `1330 (1/11)` | `RICHI-196`.

<details>
<summary>Source and cipher evidence</summary>

**Raw output — all 196 observed coordinates; unchanged key.**

```text
AKONACH18XBZGDRTRM3CNRX25089XXGEHZUZIFF1XUEBEWSGROEHRENDUNMOELZU2XFOLGTWEITERESXNACHCHEFRM4B49240X
```

**Edited output — the six observed-coordinate substitutions below.**

```text
AKONACH18XBZGDRTRM3CNRX25089XXGEHZUZIFF1XUEBERSGROEHRENXUNDOELZU2XFOLGTWEITERESXNACHCHEFRM4B49240X
```

</details>

**Readable German — the proposed word repair; abbreviations retained:**

> `AKONACH18`. Bzg. drt. RM 3 C Nr. 25089, geh. Zu Ziff. 1: Uebersg. Roehren und Oel. Zu 2 folgt Weiteres. Nach[richten]chef RM 4 B 49240.

The message cites an earlier reference, mentions `ROEHREN` and `OEL` in
connection with its first numbered point, and says further information will
follow on the second. `[richten]` expands the displayed abbreviation only;
it is not additional decoded text. `AKONACH18` and all reference numerals
remain literal.

The raw `UEBEWSG` becomes `UEBERSG`; `D` immediately after `ROEHREN`
becomes separator `X`; and `M` in the raw sequence `UNM` becomes `D`.
Each proposed plaintext change needs two coordinate substitutions. These are
language-supported repairs, not corrections to uncertain source glyphs:
all six printed coordinate symbols are legible in the crop.

| Source index, zero based | Printed | Proposed | Plaintext effect |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 14 | `G` | `D` | Position 45: `W` → `R` |
| 37 | `V` | `G` | Position 58: `M` → `D` |
| 108 | `A` | `X` | Position 55: `D` → `X` |
| 138 | `F` | `A` | Position 45: `W` → `R` |
| 139 | `G` | `D` | Position 55: `D` → `X` |
| 150 | `D` | `A` | Position 58: `M` → `D` |

The key determines 98 labels before and after the proposal. A fixed-position
count is therefore not a correctness score for these three word repairs.
The raw text remains available beside the proposed edited stream.

### Evidence, verification and credit

The source is J. Rives Childs, *General Solution of the ADFGVX Cipher System*,
printed p. 97 / PDF p. 100, headed 1 November 1918. The
[full page](../../experiments/hungary_connection_and_supplies/sources/p97_full.png),
[literal inputs](../../experiments/hungary_connection_and_supplies/inputs.json),
[coordinate certificates](../../experiments/hungary_connection_and_supplies/certificates.json)
and [reproduction notes](../../experiments/hungary_connection_and_supplies/README.md)
preserve the three headers, source rows, exact key, raw outputs and repair
ledger.

The published November 1–3 key is prior work credited to George Lasry and
colleagues. The [prior-evidence snapshot](../../experiments/hungary_connection_and_supplies/prior_evidence.json)
retains the earlier unreviewed p97 OCR candidates: C already had the same raw
body, while the A/B frames had incorrect 197/241 lengths. The complete native
A/B readings, source review and explicit C repair ledger are the present
contributions by **icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro**. No universal first-
decipherment priority is claimed.
